name: Slack Today
desc: Daily briefing in Slack over priorities, calendar, tasks.
desc_zh: Slack 里的每日简报，汇总优先级、日历与待办
solves: The morning scroll is an unpaid job. Today reads the calendar and the connected apps and states what matters, first.
solves_zh: 早上那一轮翻消息是没报酬的工作。Today 读完日历和已连接的应用，先把要紧的说出来。
best_for: You want one screen before you start, not a scroll to work through.
best_for_zh: 你希望在开工前看一屏，而不是翻一遍。
